ITEM.PTXT: When the skid control computer determines that the oversteer tendency is large, it applies the brake to the front wheel on the outside of the turn according to the degree of the tendency, generating an outward moment on the vehicle to suppress the oversteer tendency. In addition, the reduction in vehicle speed due to the braking force contributes to ensuring vehicle stability.

When the skid control computer determines that the understeer tendency is large, it controls engine output according to the degree of the tendency and applies the brakes to the front and rear wheels to reduce lateral force, suppressing the understeer tendency.
